en: Don't you start quibbling with me! You've got no right to criticize! You better watch how you talk to people!
Okay, then. A six-month subscription, you say?
Great! That'll be a big help! If only everyone were as understanding as you, my job would be a walk in the park!
Now then. Your first paper will be delivered next year.
Next year? Why does it take that long?
Come on, we're busy at the end of the year! You ought to think about people's circumstances before you go complaining about what you don't know.
You paid <Color:8>5,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You got some <Color:8>Detergent<Color:Default>.
All right, that's that, then! Thank you for choosing the Nagasu Times!
You paid <Color:8>all of your money<Color:Default>.
All right, then... Hold on. You don't even have enough to begin with!
Fine! I'll be back to collect the rest later!
(Well... I guess it wouldn't hurt to read the newspaper every now and then.)
Get out of here. And don't show your face again.
Hey, what's with the cold shoulder? I tried being nice, and this is what I get in return? You think I'm gonna turn around and leave just like that!?
You're the one sticking around where you're not welcome. I told you to get out.
You better watch your mouth, asshole. I don't take any bullshit from guys like you! Apologize to me right now! Do it!
That's no way to talk to a customer.
Don't go getting on your high horse with me. You'd better subscribe if you want to be treated like a customer!
Now you're threatening me to get subscriptions? Some salesman you are.
I'm not threatening anybody! You think I'm some sorta scam artist? You better apologize to me right now. Do it!
Okay, then. I'll sign up.
What? I thought you said I could try it out for a month, free.
Think about it. It's a no-brainer. Oh, how about I throw in some detergent as well? Would that sweeten the deal?
Tch, why didn't you say so in the first place? We could have saved us all that time!
Anyway, a promise is a promise, so I'll give you your detergent. You better not go back on the deal, though, or you'll regret it!
Your six-month subscription starts next year.
Hold on. You don't even have enough to begin with!
Know what, I'm calling the cops. You good with that?
Are you stupid or something!? The police have far better things to do than make house calls on some trumped-up charges!
Sheesh. I'm on the clock here, you know? You can forget about that generous offer now, pal.
What I want instead is compensation for wasting my time, you business-obstructing bumblefuck. Better pay up, or else!
Sorry, I didn't mean any ill will.
That right? But you know you're going to have to do better than just an apology.
You're gonna sign up for our newspaper. A simple six-month subscription. Come on, let's get this over with.
Fine, I'll subscribe to your newspaper. Satisfied?
Tch, why didn't you say so in the first place? There won't be any detergent for you, that's for sure! Oh, and delivery will start next year.
Next year? Why's it going to take that long?
You'd better not go back on the deal, though, or I'll make you regret it!
Fine, I'll pay.
That's right! Spineless worms like you need to watch what you say! I hope you learned your lesson. Now hurry up and fork over the dough.
You need to leave. Now.
You cheeky bastard! All right! I'm through playing games! Step outside and we'll settle this the hard way!
Heh. I wonder what you have in mind.
I mean I'm gonna cut the sales pitch and give your face a tune up. You're dead meat now!
Okay, I've had just about enough of this.
Huh? What are you gonna do, then? You don't think I can take your ass out!?
That's it. I'm through dickin' around! Step outside and we'll settle this the hard way!
It seems you're confused. I never said I was actually going to subscribe.
You gotta be shittin' me! All right, I'm done dickin' around. Step outside and we'll settle this the hard way!
There. You happy now?
Hmph. Fine. Apology accepted. But don't think you can get away with insulting me again!
(Finally I can get some peace.)
Okay, okay, my bad. Give me a break, just this once! I promise not to bother you again! Never ever!
I bet you've caught tons of people out with those pushy, thoughtless sales tactics, haven't you?
Oh, no, sir! Not at all!
Well you'd better drop the sales pitch altogether. If I hear you've been at it again, you'll have me to answer to. Got that?
Yup! Got it! Won't do it again! Honest to goodness!
Here, why don't you take this? Hopefully it'll make up for my inexcusable and completely uncharacteristic behavior!
You got some <Color:8>High-grade Platinum<Color:Default>.
Really, I'm sorry as sorry can be! I'll just see myself out now. Have a nice day!
Am I... dying? Me? A vampire with eternal life?
Apologize to the boss on the other side.
The boss is dating four girls in hell.
He is? How is that supposed to make me feel better!?
The boss is waiting for you in hell.
Gah... Gahahahaaa! Tatsu of Kamuro! Not bad, for a human. You could have been an even bigger villain than I!
Okay, cut!
Thanks, Kiryu-san! That was everything we needed!
Was I okay?
You were amazing, Kiryu-chan! I loved that stuff you ad-libbed there, too! That's just the kind of spice I was looking for!
Really? The words just seemed to tumble out of my mouth.
Then you've got the tumblings of genius! Even I couldn't pull off <Italic>that</Italic> level of awesome!
Well done, Kiryu-chan! You followed the script pretty well.
I'd say you've got more acting talent than me, Kiryu-san! Even if it does put my career at risk!
It could have been better, perhaps, but that's always how I feel about all my films. You did good!
Hmm, there were a few too many slip-ups, but I guess we did kind of put you on the spot.
But hey, I'd say you've still got more acting talent than me! Even if it does put my career at risk!
And those action scenes were the icing on the cake! We got some unforgettable shots that'll make people jump out of their seats!
If only the action scenes had clicked a bit better. Still, we got some presentable stuff.
Filming went really smoothly thanks to you, so I beefed up your pay quite a bit! Thanks for all the help!
You got <Color:8>100,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Good working with you again!
I get the feeling there's more to acting than I first thought.
Darn tootin'. Oh, and here's your pay! Thanks for all the help!
You got <Color:8>70,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Sorry I left everyone to hang. These things happen, ya know?
I have to admit, acting is pretty tough.
Hold on there, Kiryu-chan. I know I said that you didn't have to go completely by the script, but please try to keep it relevant.
Sorry, I guess that was pretty different.
You wanna go over the script again?
Okay, let's do this scene again! C'mon, Kiryu-chan! Action!
Yeah, I'd better do that.
Excellent! Try to get it down this time.
You finally made it, Tatsu of Kamuro!
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm here to end this, brother.<Color:Default>
You think you can kill me? Sorry, but that will never happen. I cannot be killed! For you see⑬
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're a vampire, right?<Color:Default>
So you knew? Heheh. Indeed. And all those I bite become the living dead!
Four zombies appear behind Tatsu.
Soon enough you'll join them, Tatsu of Kamuro!

Tatsu defeats the zombies one at a time.
First, he <Color:255,200,200,255>goes against the sweptback haired zombie,<Color:Default>
then defeats <Color:255,200,200,255>the zombie wearing a hat<Color:Default>.
He then finishes off the charging <Color:255,200,200,255>zombie in a flashy yellow jacket<Color:Default>.
Finally, he fights off the last <Color:255,200,200,255>zombie in glasses<Color:Default>.
Well, well. Not bad, Tatsu. You're just as I expected.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Let's see how immortal you really are.<Color:Default>
Not so fast. I still have a few cards left up my sleeve!
Countless zombies appear.
Goodbye, my brother. You might have lived, if you hadn't been so eager to unmask me!

Tatsu begins to take down the zombies.
Using his raging <Color:255,200,200,255>special techniques,<Color:Default> he fights them off, one by one.
Heheh. Not bad. But now you have to deal with me!
What will you do? I cannot be killed. Struggle all you want, but you'll never destroy me.
Tatsu readies a Japanese katana.
That blade... Is that the Hazy Moon!? It can't be! How did you get hold of it!?
<Color:255,200,200,255>The Hazy Moon you stole from the boss was fake.<Color:Default>
What? So you swapped it for the real one!?
Heheh. I see now. It seems the tables have turned.
But I shall enjoy this! For the first time, it will be a fight for my life!

Finally, the battle against the main antagonist begins.
Tatsu wields the Demon Blade, Hazy Moon.
For his <Color:255,200,200,255>final attack<Color:Default>, Tatsu uses the <Color:255,200,200,255>Demon Blade Special Technique<Color:Default>.
Tatsu of Kamuro manages to pull off a miraculous victory.
Am I... dying? Me? A vampire with eternal life?
<Color:255,200,200,255>The boss will be waiting for you in hell.<Color:Default>
Gah... Gahahahaaa! Tatsu of Kamuro! Not bad for a human. You could have been an even bigger villain than I!

Yamashiro is engulfed in flames.
Tatsu leaves and doesn't look back.

-The End-
Are you all good?
Sorry, I'd better read it one more time.
No worries at all! Take your time!
All right. I got it down.
Remember, you don't have to say the lines word for word. Just make 'em snappy and relevant!
Also, do your best with the action sequences. Ideally, we would like you to follow the script, but you'll get paid either way.
Let's get this thing rolling, then! Ready? Action!
Heheh. Not bad. But now you have to deal with me!
What will you do? I cannot be killed. Struggle all you want, but you'll never destroy me.
That blade... Is that the Hazy Moon!? It can't be! How did you get hold of it!?
The Hazy Moon you stole from the boss was fake.
The honeymoon the boss went on was fake.
What!? So, his marriage was a sham all along, was it?
What the boss gave you was merely a replica.
What? So you switched them!?
Heheh. I see now. It seems the tables have turned.
But I shall enjoy this! For the first time, it will be a fight for my life!
Interesting. You're just as strong as ever, Tatsu. You're the man I acknowledged as my brother, after all.
I'm gonna show you living hell, immortal.
Let's see if you're really immortal or not.
Not so fast. I still have a few cards left up my sleeve!
Goodbye, my brother. You might have lived if you hadn't been so eager to unmask me!
Let's see if you're really impotent or not.
Huh? Oh, I get it. You think you're longer and stronger than me, do you? I suggest you focus on the matter at hand⑬or you may find your hand cut off!
How's it going?
Howdy hey, Kiryu-chan, it's been a while! Too bad the only reason we're meeting is 'cause Kuda-chan here keeps breaking himself on everything he touches.
I'm really sorry! I don't know what I'd have done if I hadn't run into you. You're doing us a serious favor!
Not to mention, Kiryu-chan, you're perfect for this role. It's almost like it was meant to be!
Here's the script. All you have to do is <Color:255,200,200,255>memorize the parts for the lead role, Tatsu<Color:Default>.
(...I thought this was supposed to be a yakuza movie?)
So you finally made it, Tatsu of Kamuro!
I'm here to end this, brother.
I'm here for a happy ending, brother.

Heh. I don't know what you could possibly be hoping for, but
the future does not bode well for you.
I've come for justice, brother.
You think you can kill me? Sorry, but that will never happen. I cannot be killed! For you see⑬
You're a vampire, right?
So you knew? Heheh. Indeed. And all those I bite become the living dead!
Soon enough you'll join them, Tatsu of Kamuro!
You're an umpire, right?
Huh? Uh, sure? I suppose I am an umpire⑬of the undead. So killing me would be against the rules... of physics!
You're a campfire, right?
Huh? Uh, I suppose you could say I'm a campfire... Maybe because the flames of my wrath can never be extinguished? Yes, that sums it up quite nicely!
Okudera-han!
He's leavin'. Okudera-han, are ya alright?
